project_overview.name: Frameroom
project_overview.description: An open-source, self-hostable editorial gallery web app for independent photographers. Replaces paid gallery platforms like Pixieset and ShootProof with an ultra-clean, minimal, light, high-performance experience.
project_overview.stack: Next.js (App Router, JavaScript/JS), Tailwind CSS, SQLite/Prisma, S3/Local Storage, Lucide Icons

archetype_and_aesthetic.core_philosophy: The user interface recedes into the background so the photography acts as the primary visual subject. Zero distraction, ultra-sharp edge alignments, high typography contrast, generous white space, and subtle tactile micro-interactions.
archetype_and_aesthetic.tone: Sophisticated, high-fashion gallery, serene, professional, trustworthy
anti_patterns: No heavy glossy gradients or neon glow effects
No rounded bubbly cards with heavy drop shadows
No dark mode by default for public galleries (keep light gallery ambient)
No Inter font for display headlines - use high-contrast editorial serif (e.g. Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond) paired with clean geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans or DM Sans)
No cluttered standard table layouts; use airy list rows with high negative space
No centered paragraph bodies; left-align content for natural reading flow

font_family_pairing.display_serif: Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display (for editorial titles, cover heroes, studio brand headers)
font_family_pairing.sans_body: Plus Jakarta Sans or DM Sans (for UI controls, metadata, form fields, dense text)
font_family_pairing.mono_accent: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono (for date stamps, photo counts, dimensions, copy link indicators)

scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-snug

color_system.mode: Light Default with Dynamic Studio Accent Customization

layout_modes: Editorial Masonry Grid (staggered natural image ratios)
Story Scrollytelling Mode (large vertical full-width focus blocks)
key_features: Password protection gate screen with minimalist pin/password input
Hero cover photo with studio brand logo, gallery title, client name, and date
Sticky secondary bar with layout switcher, category filter tabs (e.g. Ceremony, Reception, Portraits), and 'Download All' button
Full-screen Lightbox Viewer with keyboard arrows, zoom, photo index (e.g., 04 / 85), individual download button, and close icon
Zip file bulk downloader drawer/modal with progress indicator

sections: Setup First-Run Screen: Single-owner studio setup (Photographer Name, Studio Name, Email, Password, Accent Color)
Dashboard Overview: Quick stats (Active Galleries, Total Clients, Storage Used), Quick Actions ('New Gallery', 'Add Client')
Galleries List: Searchable card/table list showing status (Published/Draft/Password Protected), photo count, client name, copy link action

Gallery Detail & Editor: Cover image upload, client assignment, drag-and-drop multi-file uploader with thumb generation progress, photo grid management (reorder/delete), password setting toggle, custom slug URL copy button
Clients Manager: Searchable client directory, add/edit client modal (Name, Email, Notes, Assigned Galleries list)
Studio Settings: Studio Name, Studio Logo Upload (with preview), Accent Color Picker (presets + custom hex input), Storage quota indicator

customization_and_branding.logo_fallback: If no studio logo image is uploaded, render stylized studio name in Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display display font with tracked out letters (e.g., L U M I N A R I A).

rules: Minimum text contrast 4.5:1 on light backgrounds
Interactive focus outlines explicitly defined using ring-1 or high-contrast border offset
Always set alt tags on photo grids (using photo filename or title)
Keyboard accessibility for lightbox viewer (Escape to close, Left/Right arrows for navigation)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete Frameroom web application in Next.js App Router using JavaScript (.js / .jsx files).

Ensure all features from Slice 1 are functional: First-run single-owner setup, Login, Admin Dashboard, Client Management (Add/Edit/List), Gallery Creation & Editing with drag-and-drop multi-photo dropzone, Photo Grid management, Share settings with password toggle and copy link, Studio Branding Settings (Logo, Studio Name, Accent Color), and Public Client Gallery view with password gate, masonry/grid views, full-screen lightbox, and download all zip functionality.
Implement studio accent color support dynamically via CSS variables `--studio-accent` applied to the public gallery view controls, buttons, and studio header.
Strictly follow the clean, minimal, light, editorial visual style: light off-white background (#FAFAFA), high contrast typography, sharp subtle borders, high negative space, zero visual fluff.
Ensure every interactive element and data input has its corresponding `data-testid` attribute as specified in `testing_and_data_testid_rules`.
Use standard Lucide icons (`lucide-react`) for UI actions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered app wrappers. Keep left alignment for reading flow.
Ensure all buttons have active/hover states with smooth color/opacity transitions.
Do not use transparent header backgrounds without backdrop blur.
Ensure images have maximum height limits on mobile viewports.
Use sonner for toasts and feedback notifications.
Every key interactive element MUST contain a kebab-case data-testid.
